author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮನದಬಲ ಹೂಹಾಸು ಜೀವನಕೆ
ಶಾಂತಮನ ಯೋಚನೆಯು ದಾರಿ ತೆರೆದಾವು
ಭ್ರಾಂತಿಯಿರೆ ಬದುಕೆಂದು ದಾರಿತಪ್ಪಿದ ಹಡಗು
ತ್ರಾತನಾಗೆಲೊ ಮನಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Inner strength of mind is a carpet of flowers for life;
thoughts of a calm mind will open the way;
with confusion, life is a ship that has lost its course;
be the rescuer of your own mind, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Inner strength smooths life’s path, and calm thinking finds a way. Confusion leaves us adrift. Take charge of your own mind.
